Evidence includes replacing a PHP monolith with Express/Next.js (0.061), building low-latency services in React and Go (0.048), and stabilizing CI/CD pipelines for production releases (0.065). Experience with REST APIs (0.120) and React (0.037, 0.065) directly maps to Cohere’s frontend and API platform work.  

**Data + ML-Adjacent Work:** Limited direct ML experience, but candidate has worked with data pipelines and scalable infrastructure. Built live dashboards streaming machine sensor data (0.061) and provisioned AWS infrastructure-as-code (0.072), relevant to Cohere’s data pipeline and ML infrastructure tasks. Familiarity with pandas and scikit-learn (0.120) provides a foundation for ML-adjacent work.

Security-first mindset evident in Auth0 MFA implementation (0.037) and decentralized identity MVP work (0.072), aligning with Cohere’s enterprise security focus.

**Recommendation:** Hire. Strong production SWE skills, CI/CD expertise, and security mindset outweigh the ML experience gap.
